svg.text: top: 1–2 courses of fired brick + earth to damp the fire
Fire tunnels (arches of green brick) every 3–4 ft, fed from both ends.
Fine fuel (sawdust, coal dust) can be mixed into the clay or spread between layers.
loose cover of old brick / iron sheet;
Walls 1–2 bricks thick, clay mortar; 4–6 ft high.
Spy-holes (plugged) let you see the color.
